create_Interaction: create an Interaction object with sender input, receiver input, labels, and message tensors
concatenate_Interaction_add: concatenate two Interaction objects using the plus operator to merge their tensor fields
create_LoggingStrategy_minimal: create a minimal LoggingStrategy that stores no fields by calling the minimal class method
dump_interactions: dump all sender receiver interactions from a Game module over a dataset into a single Interaction log
gather_distributed_interactions: gather Interaction logs from all distributed processes into one combined Interaction using torch distributed
